svg.text: How the form check was evaluated
The conditions behind every figure on the other ML charts.
application_form_v1 (an Isolation Forest, per formcheck/EVALUATION.md). Decision
Trained on 4,000 synthetic forms. Tested on 1,000 normal and 1,000 faulty synthetic
forms, generated by the same program with a fixed seed.
A form is flagged if the rules flag it OR the model flags it.
The check is advisory only: it never blocks filing and never changes routing, deadlines
or assignment. All data is synthetic. It has NOT been validated on real AICTE
applications, so none of these figures is a claim about real-world accuracy.
Provenance: MEASURED on SYNTHETIC test data (descriptive panel)
